title: How a veneer is usually placed
lead: A veneer is a thin shell fixed to the front of a tooth to change its shape or colour.

steps.label: Prepare the tooth
steps.words: A thin layer is taken off the front of the tooth, with the area numbed, to make room.

steps.label: Fix the veneer
steps.words: The shell is bonded on, then checked for colour, shape and bite.
